references.title: HSL tram network, 31 August to 31 December 2026
Aleksanterinkatu, Google Street View, August 2024
references.observation: Two mapped track axes, four flush grooved rails embedded in rectangular granite setts; no sleepers or ballast.

references.title: Kaivokatu, Google Street View, September 2025
references.observation: Two flush tracks in a central asphalt or gray paved strip beside Ateneum; raised platforms and kerbs remain distinct.

references.title: Kaisaniemenkatu, Google Street View, September 2025
references.observation: Separately mapped pair curves beside raised stop platforms; embedded rails without ballast. Panorama rendering artifact makes surface color unsuitable as an authority.

references.title: Bulevardi 3, Google Street View, August 2024
references.observation: Two track axes and four flush grooved rails in gray granite setts; no exposed sleepers or ballast, with curbed walks and parking outside tracks.

references.title: Kanavakatu 1, Google Street View, August 2024
references.observation: Two mapped axes and four flush grooved rails in paved roadway. Pale gray concrete strips within each track and dark asphalt between them; no ballast or sleepers.

references.title: Pitkäsilta, Google Street View, September 2020
references.observation: Two flush paired grooved tracks in asphalt carriageway with double white center line and raised kerbed sidewalks; no rail step at the bank.

references.title: Fredrikinkatu bridge, Google Street View, August 2024
references.observation: Two tracks embedded in asphalt carriageway with pale gray strips within each pair, raised kerbed sidewalks and metal railings. No floating tracks or sleepers.

references.title: Katajanokka canal bridge, Google Street View, August 2024
references.observation: Four rails flush with paved track strips and asphalt roadway; raised footway, stone posts and metal canal-edge railing. No visible deck seam gap or step.

limitations: OSM describes physical axes, not an engineering rail survey or a guarantee of current service.
Google/HSL references establish recognizable corridors; only licensed OSM coordinates author placement.
Bridge tracks require decoded deck/bank qualification before application; no rail elevation is inferred from OSM layer.
